title: A Harsh World Full of Uncertainty

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
One day, Nakayama Festa's homeroom
teacher visits my office out of
the blue.

text_block_list.name: Tracen Teacher
text_block_list.text:
I see... So she's not here either.
I'm sorry to
have bothered you while
you're working.

text_block_list.name: Tracen Teacher
text_block_list.text: Sigh, now what? If she doesn't get that assignment in this week, I'll have to give her a zero for it...

text_block_list.name: Nakayama's Classmate A
text_block_list.text:
Where to find Nakayama? Uh... I dunno, I
never really talk to her.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama's Classmate B
text_block_list.text:
She's kinda got a bad vibe, like you
shouldn't go near her. Like, I
heard she
literally got questioned by the police the
other day...

text_block_list.name: Nakayama's Classmate B
text_block_list.text:
Oh, um... One of my friends was out on a
jog, and she saw Nakayama
and a
policeman arguing by the riverbank.

text_block_list.name: Delinquent Umamusume
text_block_list.text: Huh? How the hell should I know? I don't care where she is, but I swear, if one more person comes whining about Nakayama this, Nakayama that...

text_block_list.name: Delinquent Boy
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, there was some guy asking around
for her. But that's nothing
new. I'm
guessing she ripped you off too, huh?

text_block_list.name: Delinquent Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Hm? What, so this isn't about some bet?
See, the thing about
Nakayama is...

text_block_list.name: Delinquent Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
I hear she's a damn good cheat at poker.
She whooped a whole pack
of idiots, and
now they're after her.

text_block_list.name: Delinquent Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
I dunno what they put on the table, but
they're lookin' for her like their life
depends on it. Yeesh. Who knows what'll
happen if they find
her?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Regardless, if there's rumors, they've got
to lead somewhere. Eventually.
Hopefully... But I've been chasing leads
without much
luck.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I've been looking around for ages now, but
all I've gotten out of it is more rumors
badmouthing Nakayama. It's just, I find
them hard to
believe, knowing how—

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Hm? Oh, Trainer. You look like a mess.
What's wrong?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I explain the chain of events—hearing
about the assignment from her
teacher,
asking her classmates where she might
be...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Her argument with the police, the rumors
of her cheating in poker,
and all the other
bad things I heard about her on and off
campus.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Hahaha.
I leave the scene for a little while,
and suddenly everyone's
makin' up fun
stories.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Goes without saying,
but none of it's true.
They really believed that I'd cheat? What
a bunch of idiots...
Where's the thrill in a rigged game?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
I guess whoever's making up rumors must
really be trying to cover their ass. They
lost, and now they're comin' up with
excuses to call me
the bad guy.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Hearing that, it makes sense. With all the
risky contests she takes on, there's bound
to be a few sore losers out there.
I can't let them scare
me off. I'm her trainer, so...

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Oh yeah? You're awful cheery about it.
There's every chance that the
people after
me might go after you.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Hmm? No matter what? Heh. Guess you
can run your mouth all you
want.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Just don't go overboard. You're my trainer, remember?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Far as I'm concerned, races are the real
contests. I'm not gonna take
on cheap
thrills that could jeopardize them.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
As long as you get that, I don't care what
anyone else thinks. All
right?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Now, let's ease up a bit—both of us.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I believe in her,
just like I have this whole
time. But... this whole
situation has driven
home that I still don't know her as well
as I should.
